facts.statement: Community event Launch Pad Party was held at the launchpads in Seaside on Server 1, with players bringing their rides to party in the sand and sky.
facts.quote: We're gathering at the launchpads in Seaside for a party of dizzying heights and spectacular tricks.

facts.statement: The US and Latin America session of Launch Pad Party was on Thursday November 4, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday November 4th, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session of Launch Pad Party was on Friday November 5, 2010 at 9:00am Pacific Time (4:00pm GMT), on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday November 5th, 2010 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community event post announcing the Launch Pad Party, held at the launchpads in Seaside on Server 1 on November 4 (US/Latin America, 3pm Pacific) and November 5, 2010 (UK/Europe, 9:00am Pacific / 4:00pm GMT). The post also explains how players find community events through the Game Guide calendar and the GO button. The exact posting date is not given (only 'Posted 3 weeks, 2 days ago').
